name: get_paper_prompt
description: Recommended default: fetch the full LaTeX source of an arXiv paper for precise interpretation of mathematical expressions.

arxiv_id.description: The arXiv ID of the paper (e.g., '2403.12345')

name: get_paper_abstract
description: Get just the abstract of an arXiv paper. Use this for a quick preview when the user hasn't read the paper yet, not when they provide an arXiv ID to discuss a paper.

arxiv_id.description: The arXiv ID of the paper (e.g., '2403.12345')

name: list_paper_sections
description: List section headings of an arXiv paper. Useful when the full paper is too long for context and you need to identify which sections to fetch individually. Returns the top-level section titles; pass one verbatim to get_paper_section.

arxiv_id.description: The arXiv ID of the paper (e.g., '2403.12345')

name: get_paper_section
description: Get a specific section of an arXiv paper by its title. Use when the full paper is too long for context or the user wants to focus on a particular section. Use list_paper_sections first to get the titles.

arxiv_id.description: The arXiv ID of the paper (e.g., '2403.12345')

section_path.description: A section title copied verbatim from list_paper_sections (e.g., 'Introduction'), including any LaTeX in it. For a subsection use 'Section > Subsection' with exact titles. Numbers such as '2.1' are not supported.

name: search_papers
description: Discover arXiv papers by topic, author, or title. Use quoted phrases for exact matches, ti:"title phrase", au:"author name", or abs:keyword. Combine terms with AND, OR, or ANDNOT. Optional categories such as cs.AI, cs.LG, stat.ML, and quant-ph are ORed together and restrict the query. Dates are inclusive submission dates in YYYY-MM-DD format (UTC). Pass a returned id to get_paper_prompt to read the LaTeX source. Requests are throttled; on rate-limit errors, wait 60s before retrying.

query.description: Topic, title, author, or arXiv search expression.

max_results.description: Maximum number of papers to return.
